exposure: Medically assisted delivery (operative vaginal delivery or unscheduled cesarean birth)
cohort: 381,199 healthy nulliparous women in the US from the 2016 US birth certificate data
finding: Epidural/spinal anesthesia was indirectly associated with non-breastfeeding at discharge, mediated through an increased likelihood of medically assisted delivery.
mod_finding: Epidural/spinal anesthesia was associated with non-breastfeeding at discharge, mediated through medically assisted delivery.
